This design drives a 7-segment display to show spinning and text at low clock frequencies (1-5 Hz), and can also output a VGA signal displaying a logo when run at 25.175 MHz with a DIP switch enabled. It uses the Tiny VGA pinout, with the 7-segment and VGA signals multiplexed on the same output pins. To use the VGA output, an external VGA monitor, cable, and the TinyTapeout VGA PMOD are required. The project is notable for combining two display modes in a single Tiny Tapeout tile and was created by a CTF team member.
